== dry-run, no sessions
[dry-run] tmux new-session -d -s demo-meta -c @WORK@/repo @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo meta
[dry-run] tmux new-session -d -s demo-api -c @WORK@/repo @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo api
[dry-run] tmux new-session -d -s demo-ui -c @WORK@/repo @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo ui
[dry-run] would write @WORK@/warp/demo-team.yaml:
# Written by scripts/meta-launch.sh from @WORK@/state/meta/team.json; rerun it rather than editing.
name: demo team
windows:
  - tabs:
      - title: demo
        layout:
          split_direction: vertical
          panes:
            - cwd: @WORK@/repo
              commands:
                - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-meta -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo meta'
            - split_direction: horizontal
              panes:
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-api -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo api'
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-ui -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo ui'
rc=0
== launch
tmux demo-meta: started
tmux demo-api: started
tmux demo-ui: started
warp: @WORK@/warp/demo-team.yaml
rc=0
== yaml
# Written by scripts/meta-launch.sh from @WORK@/state/meta/team.json; rerun it rather than editing.
name: demo team

  - tabs:
      - title: demo
        layout:
          split_direction: vertical
          panes:
            - cwd: @WORK@/repo
              commands:
                - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-meta -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo meta'
            - split_direction: horizontal
              panes:
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-api -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo api'
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-ui -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo ui'
== rerun with --lanes
tmux demo-api: running
warp: @WORK@/warp/demo-team.yaml
rc=0
== dry-run, exited lane
[dry-run] tmux respawn-pane -k -t demo-api @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo api
[dry-run] would write @WORK@/warp/demo-team.yaml:
# Written by scripts/meta-launch.sh from @WORK@/state/meta/team.json; rerun it rather than editing.
name: demo team
windows:
  - tabs:
      - title: demo
        layout:

              panes:
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo
                  commands:
                    - exec: tmux new -A -s demo-api -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json '@SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh demo api'
                - cwd: @WORK@/repo

rc=0
== tmux calls
tmux has-session -t =demo-meta
tmux has-session -t =demo-api
tmux has-session -t =demo-ui
tmux new-session -d -s keepalive sleep\ 600
tmux has-session -t =demo-meta
tmux new-session -d -s demo-meta -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh\ demo\ meta
tmux has-session -t =demo-api
tmux new-session -d -s demo-api -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh\ demo\ api
tmux has-session -t =demo-ui
tmux new-session -d -s demo-ui -c @WORK@/repo -e AW_META_CONFIG=@WORK@/state/meta/team.json @SCRIPTS@/meta-lane.sh\ demo\ ui
tmux has-session -t =demo-api
tmux kill-session -t demo-api
tmux new-session -d -s demo-api bash
tmux has-session -t =demo-api
tmux display-message -p -t =demo-api: \#\{pane_pid\}
== lane api, fresh
--session-id|@ID@|-n|demo-api|API kickoff
line two $HOME "quoted" 'single'|
== lane api, resumed
--resume|@ID@|-n|demo-api|
== lane api, resumed, AW_META_CLAUDE_ARGS
--model|x|--verbose|--resume|@ID@|-n|demo-api|
== lane ui, no prompt
--session-id|@ID@|-n|demo-ui|
== lane ui, fresh, AW_META_CLAUDE_ARGS
--model|x|--session-id|@ID@|-n|demo-ui|
== lane meta
role-set --session @ID@ --name demo-meta
== bad lane
meta-lane: bad name 'Bad Lane' (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)
rc=2
